items.note: ok the KITCHEN. double-height barrel-vaulted ceiling, a fireplace next to the breakfast table, AND a wine cellar with a tasting room downstairs. 2.3 acres. i can't.
bronxville!! five bedrooms, would look SO good with a wreath on the door.
5.5 bathrooms for 5 bedrooms. nobody in this house is ever waiting for a shower.
just hit the market this month. 3,400 sq ft in scarsdale for 1.5, honestly kind of a deal for there??

eastchester, 4 bed, just listed. putting it on your radar.

items.title: the "Pray For Me" slow-mo run
items.creator: @kemanirae_
items.body: friends run into frame one at a time in super dramatic slow motion to a slowed-down sound. the top one is at 10.3M views. it's giving action movie in a parking lot and i'm obsessed.

items.title: "what iPad?"
items.creator: @bibacosmeticsolutions
items.body: people swear on camera they do NOT own an iPad while one is very obviously hiding somewhere in the shot, and the comments turn into a where's waldo. so dumb, so good.

items.title: ghost photoshoots at the office
items.creator: @nudestix
items.body: teams are throwing white sheets over their heads, adding sunglasses, and doing a whole retro ghost photoshoot at work. we should have done this for halloween!!

items.title: everyone's doing the "Dip On Em" dance
items.creator: @joff_000
items.body: a quick one-take dance to SouthMemphisHypeman's "Dip On Em," usually two coworkers on a break. the sound's video count more than doubled in a few weeks.

items.title: "6-7" (and now "41")
items.body: 6-7 is a meaningless sing-songy answer to literally any question, with a little two-handed weighing motion. 41 is the new nonsense number they pair with it. there is no meaning. that's the point.

items.title: "glazing"
items.body: means hyping someone up SO much it gets embarrassing. like if i told you your deck was the best deck ever made in the history of decks. (it was though.)

items.title: "aura"
items.body: basically your cool factor. walking in calm and unbothered = big aura. tripping on the stairs = minus aura. kids keep score.

items.title: "standing on business"
items.body: means doing what you said you'd do, no excuses. very much a 1:1 follow-up energy, honestly.
